name: Paper Unfold Mesh
summary: Procedural paper that crumples, folds or rolls and opens frame by frame on a canvas, with writing that bends with the sheet.

distribution.label: Download skill ZIP
distribution.scope: One skill: SKILL.md, the full source of a 9-scene demo composition and the licence. No media, textures or fonts.

installation.title: Download the focused package
installation.body: Download the ZIP from the release and extract it. It holds only the skill folder; preview media and translations stay on separate branches of the repository.
installation.label: Release v1.0.1

installation.title: Add it to your agent
installation.body: Copy the extracted folder into your agent's skills directory (Claude Code: ~/.claude/skills/), or install it straight from main with git.

installation.title: Ask for a variation
installation.body: Describe the shot in plain words, for example: "Show our three steps on an accordion strip of paper that unfolds one fold at a time." Balls, squashed wads, accordions, folded notes and scrolls are covered.

manual_setup: No image model or API key is needed. It runs in plain canvas 2D with GSAP as the clock.
Supply your own paper texture, desk background and handwriting font for the demo composition.
notes: Work in progress: the skill records what went wrong and ideas not yet tried, and is updated when projects get better results.
Sister skill: Paper Unfold Frames gives a more photo-real single reveal from generated images.
